verdict.rationale: A data orchestrator could plausibly let pipelines or built-in AI features call tools from external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents the Dagster+ MCP server, where Dagster serves tools to other AI sessions, and a skill for coding agents. Neither shows Dagster acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
